task.title: Prepare Build 55 and safe Sep 23 Strength reassessment

result.summary: Codex completed the reviewed pre-production Strength graduation slice after Claude's YELLOW handoff. Native Build 55 now bounds HealthKit query and per-stream waits, serializes same-scope recovery, queues one rerun after overlapping bootstrap, completes every HealthKit observer wake exactly once, and stamps/persists Logger finishedAt for stable retry payloads. Server matching now uses the unique same-day active Logger Strength session plus the unique same-day canonical Strength workout, accepts Logger start inside the HealthKit window (or up to five minutes before), uses finishedAt or the live commit/captured instant for end alignment, and remains candidate-only. A separate guarded production operation can reassess only Sep 23 with advisory locking, expected-facts drift fencing, exact audit authorization, and post-write invariants. Strategic eligibility remains quarantined and linkAutoConfirm remains false. No deploy, production reassessment, policy mutation, TestFlight upload, manual canary, repeated workout, or Cardio work occurred. Strength has not reached its final verdict; the candidates are awaiting the Founder's deployment and later mutation approvals.

tests.summary: Native final gate: PhysiqueOSTests 1308/1308 passed, zero failures/skips; release verifier confirmed version 1.0 (55), AppIcon, HealthKit declarations, and exempt encryption. Server changed-slice gate: 7 files / 142 tests passed and eslint was clean. Mutation checks proved queued rerun, Logger finishedAt, same-scope serialization, observer completion, same-day workout uniqueness, captured_at fallback, policy safety, and authorization-bound replay. The broad Server suite was not claimed green because this sparse checkout lacks an untracked Founder runtime fixture and sandboxed listener tests fail with EPERM; the relevant command-port and changed-slice gates are green.

review.summary: A separate fresh Codex review found two moderate issues: a timed-out native sync could overlap its retry, and a Server already-reassessed path could bypass exact audit authorization. Both were fixed and re-reviewed. The follow-up review then found one native observer-completion issue on overlap; commit 621dbef3 added an atomic one-shot completion gate and regression test. Final review reported no blocker, major, or moderate findings across the completed slice.

decisions_required: Authorize deployment of Server candidate 98f8ccec5ab8eaebc25631139e574b69267f9c74. After deployment, Codex will run only the read-only Sep 23 reassessment dry-run and report the predicted mutation and invariants.

After the production dry-run, separately authorize or refuse the exact Sep 23 reassessment apply. The apply is designed to create at most one quarantined candidate and never a confirmed link or claim.
Separately authorize or refuse a Build 55 TestFlight upload when requested. No upload has occurred.
No policy mutation is currently required or proposed; any future policy mutation still requires separate explicit authorization.
unexpected_findings: Fresh review identified that the first timeout implementation could leave the timed-out operation alive while its retry began; exact-scope synchronization and delivery fences plus cancellation checkpoints now prevent overlap.
Fresh review identified that an already-reassessed production replay needed to be bound to the exact authorization audit row; replay now refuses any foreign or missing authorization audit.

Fresh review identified that an overlapping HealthKit observer wake could return without invoking Apple's completion callback; a one-shot completion gate now covers success, early staging, overlap, cancellation, feature-disabled, store-error, and upload-error paths.

With separate Founder authorization after the dry-run: apply the exact drift-fenced Sep 23 reassessment and run the post-mutation fresh zero-write audit.
With separate Founder authorization: upload Native Build 55 from candidate 621dbef3 to TestFlight and verify delivery before any live automatic-sync acceptance observation.
Reach and publish the final Strength verdict before beginning any Cardio work. Workout strategic eligibility and auto-confirm remain off throughout.
